facts.title: bowties with sugar snaps, lemon and ricotta
ingredients: 1/2 cup (about 1 ounce) finely grated pecorino romano or parmesan cheese
Glug, then drizzle, of olive oil
Coarse or fine sea salt for sprinkling
Ground black pepper or red pepper flakes
Juice of 1 lemon, plus more to taste
1 cup ricotta; use fresh if you can find or have motivation to make it
facts.yield_text: Serves 4 to 6 (main course-style), up to 8 as a first course
facts.author: Deb Perelman
